name: 94534 · Fairfield, CA
findings: ZIP 94534 (Fairfield) has 158 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94534 (Fairfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
